newsitem.title: KENYA: 33 killed in Kenyan vehicle pile-up.
newsitem.headline: 33 killed in Kenyan vehicle pile-up.

text.p: Thirty-three people were killed and 33 injured in a multiple pile-up of eight vehicles on the main road from Nairobi to Naivasha, police said on Monday.
Most of the dead were in two public-transport minibuses swept off the road when the brakes failed on a large truck coming towards them, Kenyan newspapers said.
The accident took place on Sunday afternoon at Tukei, a trading centre 70 km (40 miles) northwest of Nairobi.
